name: smwpatches-smb2-styled-health-bar
title: SMB2-Styled Health Bar
description:
This is KilloZapit's SMB2/Doki Doki Panic Health Bar with bugfixes and additional features.

Now, converted to SA-1 (including sprites), changed patch to be assembled by Asar and the sprites now uses the xkas format instead of TRASM one (and now PIXI instead of ST).

Also includes Demonsul's "Always Small Health Patch" as an optional feature.
